text:
anika: FYI Hearthline Systems CISO bumped to exec. They want a bridge today to unblock a pilot: asks are KMS integration (BYOK), on-prem connector for air-gapped inference, explicit network encryption proof, and a clear cost for a 90-day pilot with uptime SLA. Also asked for our SOC2 + pen-test evidence. Can owners please pick this up?
derek: I'll own KMS / BYOK. Short answer: we support customer-managed keys via KMS for Dedicated, and we have an on-prem package but need security review for connector access. I can draft the integration caveats by 1pm PT.
maria: I'll take the on-prem connector questions. Note: the on-prem package needs infra runbook and a staging VM for acceptance tests. ETA to list prerequisites: 4pm PT.
tom: SE here 12; will handle the pilot SLA and cost model. What throughput are they expecting for the pilot?
anika: Customer asked for 100 requests/sec sustained with p99 <300ms and 99.9% uptime. They've flagged a hard cutover deadline in 8 weeks.
derek: For BYOK, we can do KMS wrap for keys in Dedicated and Private controls. For on-prem connector we need customer to open a dedicated outbound tunnel and provide host attestations. I'll add a diagram.
maria: Acceptance tests will include latency bench, load test at 150% target, and a small pen-test window. We must require their pen-test artifacts before performing any network-level testing.
legal-bot: Legal note: SOC2 docs can be shared if we redact subject-to-NDA. Pen-test results require a signed mutual NDA. Also our standard pilot addendum limits residency guarantees. We'll prepare a draft addendum.
se-bot: ticket created: HEARTH-5021 "Hearthline exec bridge: KMS + On-prem connector + SLA" Assigned: se-oncall, infra-pilot, legal.
tom: For pricing slide propose: A) hosted metered with 15% pilot discount; B) reserved private nodes with BYOK + on-prem connector add-on. Include an ops SOW line for connector setup. I'll push a one-slide by 2:30pm PT.
anika: Good. Can someone pull SOC2 link and any redacted pen-test summary we can share in the bridge?
legal-bot: SOC2 link: Confluence > Compliance > SOC2-2025-redacted. Pen-test sharing needle: use NDA template at Confluence > NDAs > mutual-pentest.
derek: Technical caveat: full delegated-admin for customer KMS rotation isn't supported in Private without a small infra change. For the pilot we can provide a scoped key-rotation workflow where operations performs rotation on a scheduled cadence. I'll call out the timeline.
maria: For the on-prem connector, we also need a contact on their side for host attestation and a signed acceptance checklist. Asking Hearthline for those POC contacts now.
anika: Scheduling exec bridge for 2026-01-14 09:00 PST. Please RSVP. I'll include Priya Shah (CISO), Victor Chen (Head Infra), and Aisha Malik (VP Platform) from Hearthline.
tom: Will present slide + cost runway. Also will include a short failover runbook for the SLA discussion.
anika: Thanks all. I'll post the bridge invite and upload the draft slide + KMS caveats here once available. Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
